 1.  The economy of Britannica produces three goods:                      Computers        DVDs               Pizza
    computers, DVDs, and pizza. The accompanying table
    shows the prices and output of the three goods for the years    Year   Price   Quantity  Price  Quantity   Price   Quantity
    2005, 2006, and 2007.                                                                  2005  $900     10      $10       100  $15       2

                                                                  2006   1,000     10.5    12        105    16      2
      a.  Calculate nominal GDP in Britannica for each of the
                                                                  2007   1,050    12      14        110    17      3     three years. What is the percent change in nominal GDP
    from 2005 to 2006 and from 2006 to 2007?
    _____________________________________________________________________________________________
    _____________________________________________________________________________________________
     b. Calculate real GDP in Britannica using 2005 prices for each of the three years. What is the percent change in real
   GDP from 2005 to 2006 and from 2006 to 2007?
    _____________________________________________________________________________________________
    _____________________________________________________________________________________________
      c. The GDP deflator is a measure of price inflation. It is calculated by dividing Nominal GDP by Real GDP and
    then multiplying by 100. Calculate GDP Deflator Index for 2006 and 2007, using 2005 as the base year (2005 Index
   = 100). What is the percent change in the GDP Deflator from 2005 to 2006 and from 2006 to 2007?
